portable_spec.description: Small overshoot animation applied per-character. Per ADR-0011 amendment, CSS-rasterizable per-character motion qualifies as a catalog entry. The match-glyph-class filter (only [](){}<>0-9) is a future compiler extension; v1 applies the overshoot to every character of the targeted slot — Producers should aim it at slots whose content is mostly numeric or bracket-glyph (counter rest states, source-URL slots, kickers with numerals).
portable_spec.inspiration: Variable-font numeric kickers in editorial work where digits read as deliberate punctuation marks rather than continuous text.
portable_spec.usage_notes: Title-scale only. Best on kickers and source-URL slots where overshoot reads as character. Avoid on continuous body.
